Typedef
  Documentation




typedef
  struct buffer_domain buffer_domain_t


Owned, aligned payloads for synchronous and asynchronous media
    pipelines.




A returned payload pointer is an ownership token. Only pointers
    returned by this API may be released or queried; interior pointers are
    borrowed views. Capacity, allocation origin and domain lifetime are private
    implementation details. Ordinary objects continue to use
    SAFE_MALLOC/SAFE_FREE.




Buffers are exclusive until buffer_share() is called.
    Shared buffers must be treated as immutable. Each owner releases exactly
    once. Transfer a pointer by clearing the source after a successful handoff;
    failure preserves it.




Domains serialize allocation, return and trim. No allocator
    operation is suitable for a real-time audio callback: reserve and touch
    storage first.

asciichat_error_t buffer_budget_reserve
  (buffer_budget_t * budget, size_t bytes)


Budget lease for platform storage that cannot be recycled (e.g.
    pinned mappings). Zero-initialize, reserve before allocation, release only
    after disposing storage. A failed reservation preserves the lease. Never
    copy a live lease.

void
  buffer_domain_close (buffer_domain_t ** domain)

    the domain alive. Join users of the domain pointer before closing;
    outstanding payloads may be released afterwards, from any thread. Clears the
    caller's domain pointer.
